title: Which duties and offices?

knows: Selected accounts can describe distinct institutions and dated changes.

claims.text: After the 1402 battle and Timur's withdrawal, Ankara came under Mehmed's authority. In 1411 its muhafız and sancakbeyi Yâkub Bey refused a western campaign, invoking his frontier-fortress duty; Mehmed imprisoned him.

claims.text: TDV describes Yakub Bey’s disputed fortress duty and imprisonment at Ankara. Its Istanbul account names post-capture policing and judicial appointments before Mehmed returned to Edirne. Military obligation, local offices and court residence are different relations. Enslavement and confiscation remain part of conquest; neither appointment nor capture establishes universal consent or continuous control.

claims.text: What separates a captured city’s offices from the ruler’s court location? Istanbul’s named policing and judicial appointments preceded Mehmed’s return to Edirne, unlike Ankara’s specific military-duty dispute.
